content: Rahul Jain contacted insurance agent Sunita Agarwal regarding the reinstatement of his expired policy after submitting the required form. Sunita confirmed the form has been forwarded to the payments team, with a review time of 24-48 hours. Rahul questioned why the policy expired despite making an on-time payment, and Sunita apologized, explaining there was a technical issue with their payment processor. Rahul requested updates as he needs the policy active as soon as possible.

action_items: Payments team to review the reinstatement form within 24-48 hours
Sunita to keep Rahul posted on the policy status
